ja419:1.1: Idaṃ suvaṇṇakāyūraṃ muttā veḷuriyā bahū sabbaṃ harassu bhaddaṃ te mañ ca dāsīti sāvayā 'ti.
ja419:2.1: Oropayassu kalyāṇi, mā bahuṃ paridevasi, na cāhaṃ abhijānāmi ahantvā dhanam ābhatan ti
ja419:3.1: Yato sarāmi attānaṃ yato patto 'smi viññutaṃ na cāhaṃ abhijānāmi aññaṃ piyataraṃ tayā.
ja419:4.1: Ehi taṃ upagūhissaṃ karissañ ca padakkhiṇaṃ, na hi dāni punā atthi mama tuyhañ ca saṃgamo ti.
ja419:5.1: Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu puriso hoti paṇḍito, itthī pi paṇḍitā hoti tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā.
ja419:6.1: Na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu puriso hoti paṇḍito, itthī pi paṇḍitā hoti lahum atthavicintikā.
ja419:7.1: Lahuñ ca vata khippañ ca nikaṭṭhe samacetayi, migaṃ puṇṇāyateneva Sulasā Sattukaṃ vadhi.
ja419:8.1: Yo 'dha uppatitaṃ atthaṃ na khippam anubujjhati (Cfr. p.266,.) so haññati mandamati coro va girigabbhare.
ja419:9.1: Yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ khippam eva nibodhati muccate sattusambādhā Sulasā Sattukā-m-ivā 'ti.
